qualification: Saved sampled CPI bytes and clock, but two later account captures four slots apart form a hybrid local prestate. Every case first executes a signed claim to fund the token ATA; the captured creator is then replaced locally with the disposable signing key to exercise the sell authority path. This is an authorized synthetic state, not a signature by the historical creator or operator. CPMM and Lock internals run from pinned deployed ELFs. Synthetic account and slippage variants do not establish historical reachability or full source/ELF equivalence. No live transaction or funds.
